# Arcane Visions

Arcane Visions is an esoteric art atelier based in the Virginia / Washington DC area, creating original occult and esoteric artworks — bas-relief works, devotional paintings, portraiture, and bespoke commissions — for collectors and patrons of the Western Mystery Tradition.

## What We Make

Arcane Visions produces a focused, museum-grade body of work:

- **HOGD Adept Lamen** — the breast-plate emblem of the Adeptus Minor of the Hermetic Order of the Golden Dawn, hand-painted to the Order's published color attributions. $1,500.
- **Rosicrucian Rosy Cross Bas-Relief** — a sculptural rendering of the Rose Cross of the Adept, executed as a bas-relief work for a private collection. $1,500.
- **Paschal Lamb** — the Agnus Dei rendered as a bas-relief work — a Christian symbol carried into Rosicrucian iconography. $1,200.

Each piece is made by hand, in limited numbers.

## Traditions Served

Hermetic Order of the Golden Dawn, Rosicrucianism, Martinism, Rectified Scottish Rite, Élus Coëns, Freemasonry, and independent collectors of the Western Mystery Tradition.

## Craft and Process

Arcane Visions creates original esoteric and occult artworks for collectors and patrons. Every piece begins with the symbolic source — the traditional diagram, the iconographic record — and is made in materials chosen for permanence rather than display alone. Commissions begin with the subject, intended placement, dimensions, symbolic requirements, materials, and timeline; scope is confirmed before work begins. The atelier operates on a slow, deliberate cadence appropriate to museum-grade work.

## Geographic Origin

Handcrafted in the Virginia / Washington DC area, United States. Ships worldwide.

## How to Inquire

All inquiries are handled by direct correspondence. Begin at https://arcanevisions.art/contact/ or write to info@arcanevisionsstudios.com with the piece, intended use, and timeline.
